name: Second brain
blurb: One person's people, projects, notes, tasks, habits and reading, with where each piece came from.
about: Build a living second brain, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps the people, projects, notes, tasks, habits and reading of one life linked to the messages and events they came from, so what you owe someone and what to do next stay answerable as life changes. Agents capture each message and promise as it arrives, tidy the record and tell you what needs you. They write on a branch, and you merge what you accept.
